questions.question:
From the given alternatives, choose the correct meaning of the idiom.

What goes around comes around.

options.text: People's actions have consequences that will eventually return to them
People's pets will eventually return home if they go out
If you throw a stone up, it will fall down
A drunkard will eventually return home

questions.solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. People's actions have consequences that will eventually return to them.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"What goes around comes around"** refers to the concept that actions, whether good or bad, have consequences that eventually return to a person. (जो करता है वही भरता है) • **Example:** If you treat others with kindness, they will eventually reciprocate because what goes around comes around. • This idiom emphasizes the moral principle of karma or the cyclical nature of actions and their outcomes. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. People's actions have consequences that will eventually return to them.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: People's pets will eventually return home if they go out** (पालतू जानवर बाहर जाने पर अंततः घर लौट आएंगे): • This is unrelated to the idiom and reflects a literal interpretation of pets returning home. • **Example:** Cats often roam outside but eventually return home. • **Option 3: If you throw a stone up, it will fall down** (यदि आप पत्थर ऊपर फेंकते हैं, तो वह नीचे गिरेगा): • This describes a natural physical phenomenon (gravity) and does not relate to the moral or cyclical concept of the idiom. • **Example:** Stones always fall due to the force of gravity. • **Option 4: A drunkard will eventually return home** (शराबी अंततः घर लौटेगा): • This interpretation is irrelevant to the idiom's meaning and does not reflect its moral or philosophical context. • **Example:** After spending the night at the bar, the drunkard stumbled his way back home. 35:T6cb, The correct answer is **option 2 i.e. germane.**

questions.question:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.

Cast the first stone.

options.text: To be the first to criticize someone or something
To be the first to give a comment on an Instagram post
To be the first to invent something
To be the first to invite someone

questions.solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To be the first to criticize someone or something**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Cast the first stone"** means to be the first person to criticize or blame someone, often hypocritically. (किसी को आलोचना या दोष देने वाला पहला व्यक्ति होना) • **Example: **Those who cast the first stone should make sure they are innocent themselves. • This idiom is derived from biblical references, where it warns against judging others if you are not free of fault yourself. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To be the first to criticize someone or something**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: To be the first to give a comment on an Instagram post** (इंस्टाग्राम पोस्ट पर टिप्पणी करने वाला पहला व्यक्ति होना) • **Example: **She always tries to be the first to comment on her friends’ posts, but this does not relate to the given idiom. • **Option 3: To be the first to invent something** (कुछ आविष्कार करने वाला पहला व्यक्ति होना) • **Example: **Thomas Edison was the first to invent the electric bulb, but this does not match the meaning of the idiom. • **Option 4: To be the first to invite someone** (किसी को आमंत्रित करने वाला पहला व्यक्ति होना) • **Example: **He was the first to invite us to his party, but this option is unrelated to the idiom. 34:Tbbf, The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. People's actions have consequences that will eventually return to them.**

Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A government ruled by nobles.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Aristocracy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Aristocracy"** refers to a form of government in which power is held by the nobility or upper class. (कुलीनतंत्र)
 
 
• **Example:** In the medieval period, many European countries were governed by an aristocracy, where noble families held all political and economic power.
 
 
• The term signifies rule by a privileged class, often based on hereditary titles or wealth.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Aristocracy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Autocracy** (स्वतंत्र तानाशाही): A system of government in which one person has absolute power.
 
 
• **Example:** The country was ruled by an autocracy, with the king making all decisions without consulting anyone.
 
 

 
• **Democracy** (लोकतंत्र): A system of government in which power is vested in the people, who rule either directly or through elected representatives.
 
 
• **Example:** India is the largest democracy in the world, where citizens elect their leaders through voting.
 
 

 
• **Oligarchy** (अल्पतंत्र): A form of government in which power resides with a small group of people, often based on wealth, family ties, or military control.
 
 
• **Example:** The country was governed by an oligarchy, where only a few wealthy families controlled all major decisions.

questions.question:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

Robin Hood was popular ________ poor people.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**2**' i.e. **among**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The preposition **"among"** is used to indicate being surrounded by or included within a group.
 
• In this context, Robin Hood was popular **"among"** poor people, indicating that his popularity existed within the group of poor people.
 
• **Option 1 ("about")** is incorrect as it implies a general topic, not inclusion in a group.
 
• **Option 3 ("in")** is incorrect as it does not convey the idea of being part of a group.
 
• **Option 4 ("by")** is incorrect as it implies action or agency, not group association.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Robin Hood was popular **among**__ poor people."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "about"** is incorrect as it does not convey Robin Hood's popularity within the group of poor people.
 
• **Option 3: "in"** is incorrect because it does not express the relationship of popularity within a group.
 
• **Option 4: "by"** is incorrect as it implies action or agency, not the inclusion in a group.
</ul

questions.question:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

It was very stupid about the boy to have spent five thousand rupees on that dictionary.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the use of the preposition "**about**" after the adjective "**stupid**."
 
• When we use an adjective to describe someone's behavior or character in the construction "*It is + adjective + [preposition] + person + to-infinitive*," the preposition "**of**" is used.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**stupid of the boy**," as it attributes the quality of being stupid to the boy based on his action.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It was very **stupid of the boy** to have spent five thousand rupees on that dictionary."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "It was very" **– This is grammatically correct; "It" serves as the introductory/dummy subject.
 
• **Option 3: "have spent five thousand"** – This uses the perfect infinitive ("to have spent"), which is appropriate here to indicate an action that was completed in the past.
 
• **Option 4: "rupees on that dictionary."** – This part is correct. The verb "spend" is followed by the preposition "on" when referring to the object or service purchased.
 
• **Similar Adjectives:** Other adjectives that follow this "of" pattern include *kind, polite, wise, brave, silly, clever,* and *generous* (e.g., "It was kind **of** you to help").

questions.question:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

The Golden Temple was crowded by millions of devotees from all around the world on the day of Baisakhi.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the prepositional usage in the phrase "**crowded by**."
 
• In English, the verb "**crowd**" (when used in the passive voice to describe a space being full) is conventionally followed by the preposition "**with**."
 
• The phrase "**crowded with**" is a standard collocation used to indicate that a place is packed or filled with a particular group of people or things.
 
• Thus, the correct preposition should be "**with**" instead of "**by**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The Golden Temple was **crowded with** millions of devotees from all around the world on the day of Baisakhi."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "The Golden Temple was"** – This part is correct; it establishes the subject and the passive voice auxiliary verb.
 
• **Option 3: "from all around the world"** – This is a grammatically sound prepositional phrase used to denote the origin of the devotees.
 
• **Option 4: "on the day of Baisakhi."** – This is correct; "on" is the appropriate preposition used for specific days or dates.
 
• **Confusing Prepositions:** While "by" is often used in passive voice to denote the agent of an action (e.g., "eaten by"), when describing the state of being full, "with" is the idiomatic choice (e.g., "filled with," "packed with," "crowded with").

questions.question:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: "No improvement required."

Regular exercise __will have the effect of increasing your energy levels__ and help you feel more refreshed throughout the day.

options.text: will have the affect of increasing your energy levels
will affect the increase of your energy levels

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**' i.e. will increase your energy levels.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The given sentence contains the phrase **"will have the effect of increasing your energy levels"**, which is wordy and can be simplified.
 
• Option 1, **"will increase your energy levels"**, is concise and grammatically correct.
 
• Option 2, **"will have the affect of increasing your energy levels"**, is incorrect as the word "affect" is a verb, whereas "effect" (a noun) should be used in this context.
 
• Option 3, **"will affect the increase of your energy levels"**, is not grammatically appropriate because it distorts the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• Option 4, **"No improvement required"**, is not suitable as the sentence can be improved for clarity and conciseness.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Regular exercise will increase your energy levels and help you feel more refreshed throughout the day."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "will have the affect of increasing your energy levels" is incorrect due to the incorrect usage of "affect" instead of "effect."
 
• **Option 3:** "will affect the increase of your energy levels" changes the meaning of the sentence and is not appropriate.
 
• **Option 4:** "No improvement required" is incorrect as the original sentence can be improved for clarity and precision.
</ul

questions.question:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: “No improvement required.”

It was __a once-in-the-lifetime opportunity__ that many would consider invaluable, but very few got the chance to experience.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**3**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase "**once-in-a-lifetime**" is an idiomatic expression that means something very rare or unique.
 
• The article "a" is used correctly before "once-in-a-lifetime" because "once" begins with a consonant sound.
 
• **Option 1:** "the once-in-a-lifetime" is incorrect as "the" changes the meaning, implying a specific opportunity.
 
• **Option 2:** "an once-in-a-lifetime" is grammatically incorrect because "an" is used before vowel sounds, and "once" starts with a consonant sound.
 
• **Option 4:** "No improvement required" is not correct, as the underlined part requires grammatical improvement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"It was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that many would consider invaluable, but very few got the chance to experience."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Articles:** "a" is used before words beginning with consonant sounds, while "an" is used before vowel sounds.
 
• **Example:** "an apple" (vowel sound) vs. "a book" (consonant sound).
 
• **Idiomatic Expressions:** Certain phrases like "once-in-a-lifetime" follow established grammatical rules and cannot be modified arbitrarily.
</ul

questions.question: Why is Mary Wollstonecraft regarded as a foundational figure in feminist theory?

options.text: She wrote extensively about women's rights and directly challenged the notion that women were naturally weak and inferior
She focused only on her own experiences, without addressing the larger social issues affecting women and their treatment as mere property
She argued that women should stay within domestic roles and avoid intellectual pursuits
She believed women did not need education and supported traditional gender expectations

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

questions.question: What central argument does Wollstonecraft make in A Vindication of the Rights of Woman?

options.text: Women ought to recognize their inferior position as a natural obligation and therefore should not dispute the current social order.
Women's education is a necessity for their active and equal participation in society, thus overthrowing the male-dominated social structure.
Women are by nature fit for the house and should not engage in the intellect, as the quest for knowledge would disturb the social order.
The advancement of society is dependent on the confinement of women to domestic roles and the maintenance of the male-dominated structure.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Option 2: Women's education is a necessity for their active and equal participation in society...***

 
 
• The passage explicitly identifies **education** as the core of Wollstonecraft's argument. It states she "sees education as the **only means** to enable women to participate in society."
 
• She argues that the "lack of education" is what "keeps women in a secondary position," rather than any natural deficiency. By advocating for education, she seeks to move women out of this "secondary position" within the **patriarchal set-up**.
 
 
 
• ***Option 1: Women ought to recognize their inferior position as a natural obligation...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. The text says she **"rejects the conventional approach"** that categorized women as naturally weak and inferior. She views their status as a result of social conditions (lack of education), not nature.
 
 
 
• ***Option 3: Women are by nature fit for the house and should not engage in the intellect...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. Wollstonecraft's entire thesis, as described in the passage, is a **critique** of this very idea. She believed women should have the same intellectual opportunities as men to contribute to society.
 
 
 
• ***Option 4: The advancement of society is dependent on the confinement of women...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. Wollstonecraft argues that women play a "crucial role in shaping a society" specifically through their active **participation** and education, not through confinement.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vindication**: This word means the action of clearing someone of blame or suspicion, or proof that someone or something is right/justified. Wollstonecraft is "justifying" why women deserve the same rights as men.
 
• **Secondary Position**: In social theory, this refers to a group that is marginalized or has less power, autonomy, and status compared to the dominant group (in this case, men in a patriarchy).
 
• **Rationality**: A key part of her argument (implied by the rejection of "weakness") was that women are **rational beings** capable of reason, and therefore education is their birthright.
 
• **The Role of Mothers**: While she advocated for societal participation, she also argued that educated mothers would better raise the next generation of citizens, making women's education beneficial for the whole of society.

questions.question: Why did Wollstonecraft face public criticism after her death?

options.text: Her writings were viewed as too radical and were seen as a challenge to established religious beliefs.
She openly rejected motherhood and family life in her published works.
Details of her personal life, including her love affairs, became public.
She advocated Marxist-feminist ideas, which were not widely accepted during her era.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Option 3: Details of her personal life, including her love affairs, became public.***

 
 
• The passage explicitly attributes her public "disgrace" to the memoir written by **William Godwin** after her death.
 
• This memoir discussed her **"love affairs with Henry Fuseli and Gilbert Imlay,"** which effectively moved her private history into the public sphere.
 
• During that era, these revelations were used by the public and critics to overshadow her intellectual contributions and damage her reputation.
 
 
 
• ***Option 1: Her writings were viewed as too radical...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect** according to the text. While her ideas were radical, the passage specifically points to the **exposure of her private life** as the reason she "brought disgrace to her."
 
 
 
• ***Option 2: She openly rejected motherhood and family life...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. The passage states that she died in childbirth and believed women play a **"crucial role"** in society through their participation in **"bringing up children."**
 
 
 
• ***Option 4: She advocated Marxist-feminist ideas...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. The passage mentions that her ideas were **"downrightly rejected by the Marxist-feminist thinkers,"** showing she was not part of that specific school of thought.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **William Godwin's Intent**: Godwin was a philosopher and Wollstonecraft's husband. He intended the memoir to be a sincere and loving tribute, but his honesty about her life caused a severe backlash in the conservative society of the late 1700s.
 
• **Misogyny**: The passage describes the patriarchal setup as "highly misogynistic," which explains why her personal life was used as a weapon to discredit her philosophical work.
 
• **Vindication**: To "vindicate" means to prove that someone is right or justified. Her book, *A Vindication of the Rights of Woman*, sought to justify why women deserved the same rational education as men.

questions.question: In what ways did Wollstonecraft’s feminist approach stand in contrast to that of Marxist-feminist thinkers?

options.text: She limited her examination to economic equality, neglecting the cultural and social side of gender discrimination
She maintained that class struggle was a more important factor than gender equity in the pursuit of social justice
She regarded patriarchy as an illusion and considered women to be instinctively suited for the home
She highlighted the importance of motherhood in society's development, which wasn’t considered by Marxist feminists

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Option 4: She highlighted the importance of motherhood in society's development, which wasn’t considered by Marxist feminists.***

 
 
• The passage explicitly identifies this point of contention in the final sentence: **"Her idea, that women play a crucial role in shaping a society through their participation in bringing up children, was downrightly rejected by the Marxist-feminist thinkers."**
 
• Wollstonecraft argued that motherhood was a vital social office that required a rational education to perform correctly, whereas Marxist-feminists often focused on how domestic labor serves the capitalist economy.
 
 
 
• ***Option 1: She limited her examination to economic equality...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. Wollstonecraft's work focused primarily on **education and social/political rights**. It is actually the Marxist-feminists who center their analysis on the economic structures of society.
 
 
 
• ***Option 2: She maintained that class struggle was a more important factor...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. Class struggle is the defining characteristic of **Marxist** theory. Wollstonecraft's approach is considered "proto-feminist" or "liberal feminist," focusing on individual rights and equality under the law.
 
 
 
• ***Option 3: She regarded patriarchy as an illusion...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. The passage states that her work **"critiques the position of women in a patriarchal set-up,"** meaning she recognized it as a very real and harmful social structure.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Liberal Feminism (Wollstonecraft's path)**: Focuses on achieving gender equality through political and legal reform within the framework of a liberal democracy. It emphasizes **education** and **individual agency**.
 
• **Marxist Feminism**: Argues that women's oppression is tied to the system of capitalism and private property. They believe true liberation can only happen by dismantling the capitalist system.
 
• **Proto-feminist**: This term is used for thinkers like Wollstonecraft who wrote before the feminist movement was "named," but whose ideas laid the groundwork for modern gender equality.

questions.question: Which idea best reflects Wollstonecraft’s critique of patriarchy?

options.text: Women's subordination is seen as a moral duty, but through education, they can be made to understand and contest their position.
Women are naturally inferior and should be limited to domestic responsibilities, which include taking care of their family
Gender inequality is so entrenched that it cannot be addressed through social reform; that's why people should accept the patriarchal setup without any protest
Intellectual pursuits for women only result in family discord, which is why they should not break free from their pre-defined roles

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Option 1: Women's subordination is seen as a moral duty, but through education, they can be made to understand and contest their position.***

 
 
• The passage describes Wollstonecraft's work as a critique of how women **"accept their subjugation and accept slavery as a duty."** This matches the first part of the option regarding "moral duty."
 
• It further explains that she **"stressed the importance of education"** as the **"only means"** to allow women to participate in society and move out of their "secondary position," which aligns with the idea of contesting their current status.
 
 
 
• ***Option 2: Women are naturally inferior and should be limited to domestic responsibilities...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. The passage explicitly states that Wollstonecraft **"rejects the conventional approach, which categorised women as naturally weak and inferior to men."**
 
 
 
• ***Option 3: Gender inequality is so entrenched that it cannot be addressed through social reform...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. Wollstonecraft’s entire philosophy is built on the hope of **social reform through education**. She believed the "lack of education" was the cause, meaning providing it would be the solution.
 
 
 
• ***Option 4: Intellectual pursuits for women only result in family discord...***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. Far from causing discord, she argued that education would make women **more effective** in their roles, specifically in "shaping a society through their participation in bringing up children."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subjugation**: This term refers to the action of bringing someone or something under wide control or domination. Wollstonecraft's critique focuses on how women were socialized to view this control as a "natural" state.
 
• **Proto-feminism**: Since Wollstonecraft wrote in the 18th century, her ideas are "proto" (meaning "first" or "earliest") because they preceded the organized feminist movements of the 19th and 20th centuries.
 
• **The Role of Reason**: Wollstonecraft argued that because women possess the **same capacity for reason** as men, keeping them uneducated was an injustice to their humanity.
